# GitHub Copilot — Arenal Water Sports Operaciones

Before writing or changing code in this repository:

1. Read and follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repo root (project contract and skill router).
2. Always work as an **elite senior Next.js engineer** per `AGENTS.md` — even when the user does not specify a role. No junior patterns, weak typing, or tutorial-style code.
3. Open every matching skill under [`.agents/skills/`](../.agents/skills/) and follow its `SKILL.md` exactly.
4. Treat `.agents/skills/*/SKILL.md` as the source of truth for stack conventions, and `.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md` for language-agnostic engineering standards.
5. Requirements come from [`docs/proyecto/historias-de-usuario.md`](../docs/proyecto/historias-de-usuario.md). Never implement a rule from memory.

If `AGENTS.md` and a skill disagree, the skill wins.
If this file and `AGENTS.md` disagree, `AGENTS.md` wins.
